title: Gallipoli
tagline: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
about: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
cue: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.

Peel and cut the potatoes and pumpkin.Roast the lamb at 180°C until 58°C inside, adding the potatoes and pumpkin for the last hour.Rest the lamb under foil.Cook the peas, and make gravy by simmering the pan juices with the stock.Frank and Archy's Cairo kofta wrapsFrank and Archy meet again near the pyramidsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions.Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt.Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes.Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon.Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber.Grill
